narrative.intro: National Steel and Shipbuilding obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. National Steel and Shipbuilding won 15 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $126M. Obligations were up 244.5% year over year. Historical totals show variation: FY21 was $471M, FY22 was $2.2B, FY23 was $1.2B, FY24 was $1.4B, and FY25 was $550M. All figures are contract obligations except where awards are noted as total contract values. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. Use the award counts and award-size figure when sizing program-level opportunities, and use the fiscal-year obligations series when assessing year-to-year volatility in National Steel and Shipbuilding federal business.
